overview.about: The Walmart NW Arkansas Championship is a popular LPGA stop in the Ozarks at Pinnacle Country Club in Rogers, home to the retail giant's headquarters. Big corporate backing and enthusiastic local crowds make it one of the tour's best-supported weeks.
overview.nextEvent: The next Walmart NW Arkansas Championship is played at Pinnacle Country Club in Rogers. The short-course, low-scoring format and strong galleries give the week a lively atmosphere.
